rics.meaning: Real-Time Sahm Rule indicator: 3-month moving average of the unemployment rate, minus its trailing-12-month low. Triggers (signals recession) when ≥ 0.5pp.
rics.how_to_use: Among the cleanest historical recession signals — has fired at the start of every US recession since 1970. A trigger doesn't make a recession inevitable, but flagging it warrants caution. Watch alongside NFP, claims, and yield curve.
